nodes.description: Mapping address => StrategyParams holding weightage, performance fee, activation and last balance for each strategy.
Array of strategy addresses tracked by the fund.
FundStorage slot _TOTAL_INVESTED_SLOT tracking total underlying invested in strategies.
FundStorage slot _TOTAL_ACCOUNTED_SLOT tracking total underlying accounted for.
Initializer that sets up ERC20, ReentrancyGuard, governance and fund storage.
Adds a new strategy with weightage and performance fee; guarded by onlyFundManagerOrGovernance.
Removes an active strategy and withdraws all funds from it.
Updates weightage of an active strategy.
Updates the performance fee of an active strategy.
Computes and transfers strategy creator, fund manager and platform fees from fund balance.
External entry point that processes fees and rebalances/allocates capital to strategies.
Invests newly available underlying to strategies proportionally without a full rebalance.
Rebalances all strategies to their target weightage.
nonReentrant external deposit of underlying for msg.sender.
nonReentrant external deposit of underlying on behalf of a holder.
Internal deposit routine: enforces limits, mints shares and pulls underlying via safeTransferFrom.
nonReentrant external withdrawal: burns shares, pulls from strategies and transfers underlying minus fee.
Sets the fund manager address.
Sets the platform rewards address.
Governance-only rescue of mistakenly sent tokens.
msg.sender: caller of external functions, used for auth checks, deposits, withdrawals and fee recipients.
block.timestamp: used for strategy activation, last hardwork timestamp and annualized platform fee.
External token transfers to strategy creator, fund manager rewards and platform rewards inside processFees.
External safeTransferFrom pulling underlying from the depositor into the fund.
External safeTransfer of underlying to msg.sender (and platform rewards) in withdraw.
External safeApprove granting unlimited allowance to a newly added strategy.
amount parameter of deposit(uint256).
holder parameter of depositFor(uint256,address).
amount parameter of depositFor(uint256,address).
numberOfShares parameter of withdraw(uint256).
newStrategy parameter of addStrategy.
weightage parameter of addStrategy.
performanceFeeStrategy parameter of addStrategy.
activeStrategy parameter of removeStrategy.
activeStrategy parameter of updateStrategyWeightage.
newWeightage parameter of updateStrategyWeightage.
newFundManager parameter of setFundManager.
newRewards parameter of setPlatformRewards.
_token/_sweepTo parameters of sweep.
toMint local variable in _deposit holding shares to mint.
underlyingAmountToWithdraw local variable in withdraw.
profitToFund accumulator in processFees.
profit local variable per strategy in processFees.
strategyCreatorFee local variable in processFees.
fundManagerFee local variable in processFees.
platformFee local variable in processFees computed from block.timestamp.
availableAmountToInvest local variable in doHardWorkWithoutRebalance.

edges.reason: deposit delegates the actual work to internal _deposit.
depositFor delegates the actual work to internal _deposit.
amount parameter flows into deposit.
amount parameter flows into depositFor.
holder parameter flows into depositFor and is validated.
msg.sender is used as sender and beneficiary in deposit.
msg.sender is used as sender in depositFor.
msg.sender-derived sender is passed into _deposit.
deposit amount used to compute shares to mint (toMint) with multiplication/division.
toMint is minted to the beneficiary inside _deposit.
_deposit performs an external token transfer via safeTransferFrom.
deposit amount is the value pulled from the sender via safeTransferFrom.
numberOfShares parameter flows into withdraw.
msg.sender is the share holder and transfer recipient in withdraw.
numberOfShares converted to underlying amount via multiplication/division.
computed underlyingAmountToWithdraw is sent to msg.sender via safeTransfer.
withdraw performs external token transfers to msg.sender and platform rewards.
External transfer to msg.sender can invoke a callback that reenters withdraw (guarded by nonReentrant).
safeTransferFrom into the underlying token can invoke a callback during _deposit.
safeTransfer to creator/rewards during processFees can invoke a callback reentering fee processing.
processFees performs external token transfers to fee recipients.
accumulated profitToFund drives fund manager fee transferred to rewards.
per-strategy profit is added into profitToFund.
strategyCreatorFee is subtracted from profitToFund (subtraction risk).
fundManagerFee is transferred to fund manager rewards.
platformFee is transferred to platform rewards.
platformFee depends on block.timestamp minus last hardwork timestamp.
Strategy activation timestamp is set from block.timestamp in addStrategy.
doHardWork stores block.timestamp as last hardwork timestamp, governing fee timing.
processFees iterates over strategyList.
processFees reads/writes strategies mapping balances and fees.
doHardWork calls processFees before reallocating capital.
doHardWork routes to doHardWorkWithoutRebalance when no rebalance is needed.
doHardWork routes to doHardWorkWithRebalance when shouldRebalance is set.
availableAmountToInvest computed by subtraction and used to size strategy allocations.
newStrategy parameter is validated and registered in addStrategy.
weightage parameter is checked against max investment in addStrategy.
performanceFeeStrategy parameter is bounded by MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE_STRATEGY.
addStrategy pushes the new strategy into strategyList.
addStrategy writes StrategyParams for the new strategy.
addStrategy grants an allowance via safeApprove to the new strategy.
newStrategy is the spender in the safeApprove call.
activeStrategy parameter selects which strategy to remove.
removeStrategy mutates strategyList (shift and pop).
removeStrategy deletes StrategyParams and updates indices.
activeStrategy parameter selects the strategy to update.
newWeightage parameter updates strategy weightage.
updateStrategyWeightage writes the strategies mapping.
updateStrategyPerformanceFee writes the strategies mapping.
newFundManager parameter flows into setFundManager storage write.
newRewards parameter flows into setPlatformRewards storage write.
sweep token and destination parameters flow into the sweep transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Deposit amount parameter is only meaningful as input to the deposit entry point.
holder parameter is only used inside depositFor.
amount parameter is only used inside depositFor.
numberOfShares parameter is only used inside withdraw.
newStrategy parameter is only used inside addStrategy.
weightage parameter is only used inside addStrategy.
performanceFeeStrategy parameter is only used inside addStrategy.
activeStrategy parameter is only used inside removeStrategy.
activeStrategy parameter is only used inside updateStrategyWeightage.
newWeightage parameter is only used inside updateStrategyWeightage.
newFundManager parameter is only used inside setFundManager.
newRewards parameter is only used inside setPlatformRewards.
token and destination parameters are only used inside sweep.
toMint is a short-lived local computed and consumed inside _deposit.
underlyingAmountToWithdraw is computed and consumed inside withdraw.
profitToFund directly determines the fund manager transfer amount.
per-strategy profit feeds the fee transfers inside processFees.
strategyCreatorFee is the amount transferred to the strategy creator.
fundManagerFee is the amount transferred to fund manager rewards.
platformFee is the amount transferred to platform rewards.
availableAmountToInvest is computed and consumed only inside doHardWorkWithoutRebalance.
